question_summary: An unforeseen utility line was discovered beneath the slab area at Pour 3, conflicting with the planned layout; foreman requests direction on a proposed local layout shift.
proposed_solution: Shift the slab layout locally in the conflict area and hold everything else per plan.
deadline_text: A response next week would still let us stay on track.
routing_rationale: The conflict involves an underground utility line, which falls under civil/site utility design responsibility, though it also affects structural slab work.
